causal_closure.classification_rule: A frozen adapter may remain nonpromoted, but efficacy is not called negative unless the mechanism differs from its matched control on an actionable headroom case whose independent near-basin starts are solvable by the fixed local pipeline.

shared_local_barrier.near_rank_d8: All arms exhausted essentially 600 callbacks; residuals near 1e-12 still had large forward error and no complete h/h2 correction reserve.
shared_local_barrier.multiroot_d4_d8: Float64 rank evidence cannot resolve the approximately 1e-40 to 1e-38 weak derivative; very small residual stationary nonroots remain unsafe.
shared_local_barrier.next_axis: condition-triggered rank-revealing adaptive-precision endpoint rescue before another discovery efficacy run

mechanism_activation.cause: Any exact division-score tie invokes the global orbit fallback, so the MultiRoot headroom cases are bit-identical to the geometry-only control.

DIRECT_RECT_EMIT.reopen_gate: Use a new ID with set-valued tie-equivariant simultaneous processing; pass signed-permutation and orthogonal set-covariance, show source contrast on actionable headroom, then compare at frozen 48/96/192 emitter work.

mechanism_activation.cause: The 2^d+1 cube-corner base is typed inapplicable at d8; in two formally applicable d4 cases no complete invariant refinement shell fits the remaining 31 slots.

SIMPLICIAL_STAR_EMIT.reopen_gate: Define effective applicability as at least one complete refinement shell and candidate/control source contrast; a d8 successor must use a separately specified polynomial-size symmetric base such as a 2d+1 cross-polytope.

mechanism_activation.cause: Every case reached the raw cap. Most source contrast against D0 came from a different fresh-IID fallback namespace rather than accepted ECP points.

ECP_LB_FULL.reopen_gate: First reproduce the paper/official trace, calibrate raw-cap and epsilon/tau/C fill curves without Gold, require typed parameter-inapplicability when 48 accepted screens cannot be filled, and compare accepted-slot replacement against an all-fallback-IID control.

decision.retain: aggregate, causal classification, reopen gates, candidate/source/executable hashes, ignored raw artifacts, and recoverable candidate commits
decision.next_general_failure_class: hard local convergence and rank instability under the fixed 600-callback cap
decision.next_axis: compare preregistered budget-reserved rank-aware Float64 correction and condition-triggered adaptive-precision correction against unchanged E4 on parameterized NearRank, Curved, and MultiRoot strata before changing discovery again

general_conclusion: The Stage-D performance result is valid and none of the three frozen adapters advances to production. It is not an efficacy rejection of DIRECT, simplicial/SHGO, or ECP as method families: the actionable headroom set contained no case with candidate-specific treatment contrast and a locally solvable basin. DIRECT was neutralized by its global exact-tie fallback, the 48-slot cube-star was ineffective or inapplicable on all headroom cases, and ECP was dominated by raw-cap starvation plus a confounded fresh-IID fallback. D0 remains the discovery source. The next research cycle repairs the common hard-local-convergence/rank-precision barrier; discovery successors may reopen only through the recorded mechanism-specific gates.
